subject.title: Feishu doc tool returns raw 429/504 to the model with no backoff, write serialization, or idempotency — causes rate-limit storms and duplicate blocks

question: Should the Feishu plugin own a bounded per-document write coordinator and an explicit unknown-outcome contract for document mutations, or should cross-turn/resource serialization be designed in the shared execution layer?
rationale: The report mixes tool-local HTTP retry handling with cross-turn write coordination; choosing the owner boundary and 504 recovery semantics requires maintainer intent and Feishu API-contract review.

options.title: Validate a plugin-local coordinator
options.body: Confirm Feishu API retry and verification semantics, then implement narrowly within the Feishu document-tool path while leaving cross-turn queue policy separate.

options.title: Design a shared resource lease first
options.body: Route serialization through a generic execution-layer lease only if maintainers want the same resource-conflict semantics across channels and tools.

recommendation.title: Validate a plugin-local coordinator
recommendation.body: Confirm Feishu API retry and verification semantics, then implement narrowly within the Feishu document-tool path while leaving cross-turn queue policy separate.
